svg.title: Six serving bottlenecks route to six different quantization starting points
svg.desc: Weight memory pressure starts with W4A16 weight-only quantization, compute-bound throughput starts with FP8 or INT8 W8A8, long context or high concurrency starts with KV-cache quantization, local or edge inference starts with GGUF, adapter fine-tuning starts with NF4 and QLoRA, and diffusion pipelines need diffusion-specific INT4 or FP8 methods. Every path still needs calibration and evaluation on the target runtime before it ships.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The same bit-width can be right or wrong depending on hardware, runtime, cache, and evaluation.
